title: 面向大规模动态图的图神经网络优化机制研究

novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法——GSAERU 模型。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method based on graph summarization—GSAERU model.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻上原图快照的序列。
在单时间步上将图快照输入图表征学习模块。
通过图摘要技术对原图进行压缩。
将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器。
利用和原图的重构误差训练原图节点的表征。
通过循环神经网络学习原图在时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系。
在四个真实世界的大规模图数据集上进行了大量实验验证。
与传统图神经网络算法相比，平均内存消耗和平均训练时长分别降低了9.86%和13.27%。
technical_features_en: Modeled the dynamic sequence graph as a sequence of snapshots of the original graph at each moment.
Inputted the graph snapshots into the graph representation learning module at a single time step.
Compressed the original graph through the graph summarization technology.
Inputted the compressed new graph into the graph autoencoder.
Trained the representation of the nodes of the original graph using the reconstruction error with the original graph.
Learned the feature information and dependencies of the original graph in the time dimension through a recurrent neural network.
Conducted extensive experiments on four real-world large-scale graph datasets.
Compared with the traditional graph neural network algorithm, the average memory consumption and average training time were reduced by 9.86% and 13.27%, respectively.
